```json
 "rationale": "A single-stage 5T OTA works because the gain spec is low (26 dB) and a single dominant pole at CL gives about 80 deg of phase margin. gm1 is about 750 uS for a GBW near 60 MHz into 2 pF, which needs about 63 uA per side (130 uA tail) at gm/Id 12. Slew is about 65 V/us, so settling is under 25 ns. The NMOS input pair suits VCM = 0.9 V. A PMOS mirror at L = 0.5 keeps the mirror pole above 350 MHz. Expected A0 is about 30 dB."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.35, 0.15, 1.0),      # input pair L
    "Itail": (130e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),# tail current
    "gmid3": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),       # PMOS mirror L
    "gmidt": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),       # tail mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; I1 = It / 2

    # PMOS mirror load (diode M3 / output M4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.7)
    vout_q = vdd - m3.vgs
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.12)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(vout_q - vtail, 0.2))
    # tail and reference diode (same gm/Id, L -> ratio It/iref)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], It, vds=vtail)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # vinp -> diode side => non-inverting
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a0 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # mirror pole-zero doublet (zero at 2*fp2) softens phase loss
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * fp2)))
    sr = It / cout
    vstep = 0.5
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    t_slew = max(vstep - 2 * I1 / gm1, 0) / sr
    settle = t_slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = vdd * (It + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "settle": settle,
               "slew": sr, "power": power}
```
